sentences.en: Monkeys are arboreal animals which make themselves at home in genealogical trees.
sentences.zh: 猴子是arboreal动物，它们在家就在基因树上。

sentences.en: The house was built among the arboreal canopy, offering a cool retreat.
sentences.zh: 房子建在茂密的树冠中，提供了一个凉爽的避暑地。

sentences.en: Many birds have an arboreal lifestyle, nesting in high branches.
sentences.zh: 许多鸟类过着树木栖居的生活，它们会在高枝上筑巢。

senses.zh: 树的, 乔木的, 树栖的。
